answer: Because the dune liability is recorded in the ferrous ledger at admission, the nebula audit makes public the shared exposure and internal sponsorship is self-defeating. A sponsor carries 37% of any slash its member incurs, so vouching is a financial position rather than a courtesy. A farm must therefore place its own capital behind each alias it sponsors, which is the same as paying the bond twice for each key it runs. That is 16 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
